item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
## What's Changed
* Your Claude Code, Codex and Kimi Code sessions in the notch: which one is working, which one needs you and which one is done * Approve or deny permission requests right from the island, with the full command, path or diff in front of you * A Done card with the agent's last answer when it finishes * 5-hour and weekly usage limits for Claude, Codex and Kimi * An animated pixel mascot for each agent * Notch or floating island; the island's width is adjustable and you can drag it sideways along the top edge * Show the island in every app, only in the apps you choose, or everywhere except them * File shelf: drop files on the notch and drag them back out when you need them * Optional widgets: music, calendar, timer and system * English and Russian * Automatic updates
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pytodai/NotchBuddy/commits/v1.0
